facts.fact: Clive 在阿根廷学德国移民烹饪；十年「寻找自我」已十个月
facts.anchor: I’m in Argentina visiting a German settlement

facts.fact: Clive 道歉——旅行中学会了很多
facts.anchor: I was such a bastard to you before. I’m sorry.

facts.fact: 关键：她需要有人告诉她「可以走」——Clive 说了
facts.anchor: I needed someone to tell me I was allowed to leave.

facts.fact: 未 unpack 的行李＝该走的信号；在 Max 家两小时就 unpack
facts.anchor: I unpacked at Max’s within two hours of waking.

facts.fact: 结尾：望着那栋房子，如释重负——大概再也不会回来
